question: Poonam Yadav won the 2019 Arjuna Award for which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cricket.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poonam Yadav:**

 
 
• Poonam Yadav is an **Indian cricketer** who plays for the Indian women's cricket team.
 
• She plays for Central Zone, Uttar Pradesh, and Railways in domestic cricket.
 
• She received** Arjuna Award in the year 2019**.
 
• Poonam Yadav is ranked** second in women's T201** rankings for bowlers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mithali Raj:**

 
 
• Captain of the India women's team, Mithali Raj on 12 March 2021 became the first woman cricketer from the country and only the second overall to score **10,000 international runs.**
 
• Mithali Raj, playing her** 212th ODI **for India, achieved the landmark during the third match of the bilateral series against South Africa.
 
 
 
• **Smriti Mandhana **-
 
 
• Smriti was born on** 18 July 1996 in Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
 
• His father is Srinivas Mandhana and his mother is Smita Mandhana.
 
• He also has a brother named Shravan Mandhana who is a former district-level cricketer.
 
• Smriti has made her place in cricket with her good performance.
 
• He has also received the** ICC Player of the Year award in the year 2016**.
 
• She is the first female player to get this title.
 
• She has been named as the winner of the **Rachael Heyhoe Flint Trophy** for ICC Women's Cricketer of 2021.
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur** -
 
 
• She is an Indian female cricket player.
 
• In** November 2018**, she became the first woman from India to score a century in a** Women's T20 International**.
